translated_title: Companies Lobby Against Mexican Reform That Would Require Them to Report the ‘Definitive’ Price
original_title: Cabildean empresas contra reforma que las obligará a informar precio “definitivo”
author: Enrique Méndez
meta_description: Netflix, Uber, Rappi and DHL are pressuring Congress to weaken Morena's bill against 'drip pricing,' the hidden fees tacked onto a low advertised cost.
